Equipped with the factory removable hard top, this Wrangler offers the versatility of open-air driving while providing improved insulation, security, and year-round comfort compared to traditional soft-top models. Available configurations include the popular 3-piece Freedom Top hardtop system, allowing drivers to remove front roof panels or the full top for a customizable driving experience.

The Sahara trim comes standard with the 2.0L turbocharged inline-4 engine producing 270 horsepower and 295 lb-ft of torque, paired with an 8-speed automatic transmission and Jeep Command-Trac 4x4 system. This setup delivers strong low-end torque, smooth highway performance, and excellent off-road capability in all weather conditions.

20 MPG city
2024 MPG highway
depending on configuration and equipment.

Body-color hard top and fender flares

12.3-inch Uconnect 5 touchscreen
Wireless Apple CarPlay and Android Auto
Remote start and proximity key entry
Adaptive cruise control and advanced safety technology on equipped models

Heavy-duty Dana axles
Hi/Low-range gearing
Strong approach and departure angles
Excellent ground clearance
Water-fording capability


The four-door Sahara configuration also provides impressive practicality with:

Seating for up to five passengers
Approximately 31.7 cubic feet of rear cargo space
Over 67 cubic feet of maximum cargo capacity with seats folded


The removable hard top adds major advantages for buyers wanting:

Better cabin insulation and quieter highway driving
Rear defroster and rear wiper functionality
Improved winter-weather comfort
Enhanced durability and security

description:
The 2017 Chevrolet Tahoe Premier offers a commanding presence of full-size luxury and proven capability, finished in an elegant Pearl exterior. Powered by the advanced EcoTec3 5.3L V8 engine delivering 355 horsepower and 383 lb-ft of torque, this flagship SUV provides effortless towing power and confident performance through its smooth 6-speed automatic transmission and a robust Autotrac 4WD system for reliable traction in all conditions.

The top-tier Premier trim outfits the Tahoe with distinctive 20-inch polished aluminum wheels, all-season touring tires, and a bold chrome grille with signature LED lighting. Inside, you'll find premium leather-appointed seating surfaces with heated and ventilated front seats, a leather-wrapped steering wheel with wood accents, and elegant interior trim with authentic wood inlays. The spacious three-row cabin offers comfortable seating for up to eight, along with tri-zone automatic climate control and a premium 10-speaker Bose Centerpoint audio system.

Advanced technology features include the Chevrolet MyLink infotainment system with an 8-inch touchscreen, navigation, Apple CarPlay and Android Auto integration, and a 4G LTE Wi-Fi hotspot. The Tahoe Premier also boasts a power liftgate, a rear-seat entertainment system, and the comprehensive suite of available safety technologies including forward collision alert and lane keep assist for enhanced utility, comfort, and confidence.

Engineered for those who demand premium luxury with full-size capability, this Tahoe achieves an EPA-estimated 15 MPG city/21 MPG highway while offering a robust 8,400 pounds of maximum towing capacity when properly equipped.

Owning a Porsche is a dream for many, and the 718 Boxster GTS makes that dream a reality. With its exceptional craftsmanship, exhilarating performance, and head-turning style, this sports car is the embodiment of Porsche's unwavering commitment to excellence.

We invite you to experience the power and prestige of the 2025 Porsche 718 Boxster GTS for yourself. Visit our showroom today and let our knowledgeable sales team guide you through the features and capabilities of this remarkable vehicle. Prepare to be captivated by the ultimate in sports car perfection.

LOADED WITH CARBON FIBER, FRONT AXLE LIFT SYSTEM, RACING SEATS, AND MORE!

OVERVIEW
The Ferrari 458 Spider represents the bygone era of naturally aspirated Italian engineering––an intoxicating blend of design and sound that captures the soul of Maranello. As the predecessor to the 488 GTB and later the F8 Tributo, the 458 laid the groundwork for some of the most enthusiast-respected supercars of the modern era––making it a true standout in Ferrari history. At its core lies a 4.5-liter naturally aspirated V8 engine, developed entirely in-house by Ferrari. Producing 562 horsepower at 9,000 rpm and 398 lb-ft of torque, it delivers a howling crescendo that few engines––before or since––can match. Paired with a 7-speed dual-clutch transmission, the 458 surges from 0-60 mph in just 3.3 seconds and reaches a top speed of 202 mph. Its aluminum space frame, magnetorheological dampers, and E-Diff3 electronic differential deliver extraordinary balance and agility, while the F1-Trac traction control system ensures confidence without compromise. Visually, the 458 is an icon of the past decade. Created by Pininfarina, its sculpted body is not only beautiful but aerodynamically purposeful: the front intakes channel air to cool the brakes, while the signature triple exhaust and rear diffuser manage downforce with ease. Even over 10 years later, its form and silhouette remain timeless. Behind the wheel, the cabin wraps the driver in black/yellow leather, with Ferrari's signature manettino steering wheel and carbon fiber throughout reminding you of its sport intentions. Leather, Alcantara upholstery, and driver-centric layout create an immersive environment that feels equal parts luxury and performance. The Ferrari 458 Spider stands out as one of the purest modern Ferraris ever built––free of turbochargers, electric motors, or digital dilution. For collectors and purists alike, the 458 remains a benchmark: a supercar that celebrates sound, sensation, and pure driving pleasure.

description: This 2002 Chevrolet Camaro SS is a 35th Anniversary edition convertible that was modified by SLP Engineering when new, with changes including an Auburn high-torque differential, a performance-tuned exhaust system, and Bilstein suspension components. The car is finished in Bright Rally Red with silver racing stripes over two-tone Ebony and gray leather, and it is powered by a 5.7-liter LS1 V8 paired with a four-speed automatic transmission. Additional equipment includes a power-operated soft top, a Monsoon audio system, and 17" aluminum wheels. The car is from the final production year for the fourth-generation Camaro and is finished in Bright Rally Red (81) with silver racing stripes. Additional exterior details include a power-operated black convertible soft top, a forced air-induction hood, an SS-specific rear spoiler, fog lights, and four exhaust outlets. Polished 17? aluminum wheels with black recesses are wrapped in 275/40 Goodyear Eagle F1 GS tires. The Bilstein Ultra Performance Suspension package was installed by SLP Engineering when new, and the car is also equipped with four-wheel anti-lock disc brakes and traction control. A power steering fluid flush was performed in August 2021. The cabin features two-tone Ebony and gray leather upholstery on the seats as well as a matching dashboard, center console, door panels, and carpets. Commemorative badging is present on the center console, and the headrests have 35th Anniversary embroidery. Amenities include a power-adjustable driver’s seat, air conditioning, cruise control, remote keyless entry, an alarm system, and an eight-speaker Monsoon audio system with an amplifier, an AM/FM/CD stereo, and a remote 12-disc CD changer. The leather-wrapped steering wheel frames a 155-mph speedometer, a tachometer, and gauges for fuel level, coolant temperature, oil pressure, and voltage. The digital odometer indicates 228 miles. The 5.7-liter LS1 V8 is equipped with a Blackwing SLP intake and a performance exhaust system. Output was rated at 345 horsepower when new. The seller notes that the battery was replaced in August 2021, and an oil change was carried out in preparation for the sale. Power is sent to the rear wheels through a four-speed automatic transmission, and the car is equipped with the Auburn High Torque Performance package. The window sticker lists initial delivery to Stevinson Chevrolet West in Golden, Colorado as well as colors, standard and optional equipment, and a total price of $37,335. An SLP Engineering installed options sheet can be viewed in the gallery below. This car was first delivered to Stevinson Chevrolet West in Golden, Colorado. It belonged to the Chevy Dealer that personally ordered it to keep in his personal collection. This special-edition Camaro SS has 228 miles and is offered with manufacturer’s literature, window sticker, an SLP Engineering installed options sheet, two keys fobs, 35th Anniversary floor and deck mats, clean Carfax report, and clear title. Convenience
  • Cruise control with steering wheel mounted controls. Set it and forget it. Road trips used to be stressful, until cruise control set the pace. Simply set the desired speed using the steering wheel mounted controls and it will maintain that speed without driver intervention. This can help minimize driver fatigue and improve overall fuel economy. Resting your right foot is right at your fingertips thanks to cruise control with steering wheel mounted controls.
Safety and Security
  • Forward collision mitigation - Forward thinking. You look away for just a second and suddenly the vehicle in front of you has stopped. That's when the forward collision mitigation system comes to life. When it senses an impending impact, it will activate a combination of features to help prevent or reduce the severity of an accident. Forward collision mitigation is always looking ahead.
  • Pedestrian impact prevention - An extra step toward safety. Pedestrians don't always stop, look, and listen, but with Pedestrian Impact Prevention, your vehicle is equipped to better see them and avoid them. This system constantly monitors the road ahead to identify and track pedestrians. It projects that image to an interior display screen, AND should an impact become likely, Pedestrian impact prevention takes steps to avoid a collision.
  • Rear camera - Watching your back! The rear camera helps you see obstacles and hazards you otherwise couldn't by showing enhanced images of what is behind you. The rear camera is an extra set of eyes that's both convenient and safe.
  • Lane departure prevention - Keep it between the lines. It only takes a moment of inattention for your vehicle to drift. With lane departure prevention, your vehicle takes corrective action to help you avoid unintentionally moving out of your lane. Lane departure prevention is an extra level of safety for you and those around you.
  • Head-up display - Keep your head up! You don't have to take your eyes off of the road to get information from your dashboard anymore. With head-up display, important driving information - like speed and RPM's - displays on your windshield in your line of sight. Because when you're driving, the most important information lies on the road ahead. Keep your eyes on the road with head-up display.
  • Brake assist - Stop right there. Something jumps out into the middle of the road and you need to stop now! With brake assist, you will. It uses the speed of the brake pedal's travel to sense panic braking, then applies all available power to boost your stopping power. Brake assist can stop the accident before it is one.
Technology and Telematics
  • Smart device mirroring - Smartphone, meet smart car. You can control your device through your vehicle's infotainment system. Smart device mirroring brings together safety and convenience by making it easier to find what you're looking for while keeping your eyes on the road.
